newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Nordstrom & Thulin owner sells 9.6 mln shrs.
newsitem.headline: Nordstrom & Thulin owner sells 9.6 mln shrs.

text.p: Swedish shipping company Nordstrom & Thulin AB (N&T) said on Friday its main owner Ronald Bergman would sell 9.65 million A-series shares to Austrian shipping magnate Helmut Sohmen.
Sohmen will control 16.2 percent of the capital and 66 percent of the votes in the company, N&T said in a statement.
Sohmen is the head of tanker and cargo operator World-Wide Shipping and has been a board member of N&T since 1994.
N&T, listed on stock markets in Stockholm and Oslo, is the main owner of tanker operator Nord Jahre Tankers.
Bergman will remain chairman of N&T's board and Anders Berg will remain managing director, N&T said.
